qr_payload: Welcome to Northfield Institute of Technology. New students should report to the Academic Block lobby between 08:30 and 09:30 on the first day of orientation, carrying their admission letter and a photo ID. Volunteers wearing orange badges will guide you to your department briefing. The briefing covers timetables, laboratory safety, library membership, hostel mess timings and the student support desk. Lunch is provided in the central dining hall at 13:00. In the afternoon, club representatives will present short demonstrations at the Main Quadrangle, followed by a campus walk led by senior students. Please wear comfortable shoes and carry a water bottle. If you have questions before the day, contact the Office of Student Affairs by e-mail at student.affairs@example.com during working hours. We look forward to meeting you.
